prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to sync your adoption certificate and keep your pet safe across all devices.", "Save Pet & Continue"]
1: ["Tips for the Best Custom Pet", "Upload a clear, well-lit photo of your pet facing forward for accurate 3D model generation.", "Got It, Choose Photo"]
2: ["Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn the quick shortcuts to bring your pet to the front or send them to the system tray.", "Finish Setup"]
3: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Choose an instant pre-made companion or generate a custom pet from your photos.", "Instant Pet: Ready Immediately", "Custom Pet: Made From Photo"]
4: ["Sign In to Access Your Pets", "Your adopted pets and settings are securely linked to your account and will restore automatically.", "Signing in ensures your desktop pet remains saved."]
5: ["Best results: clear lighting, neutral background, subject centered."]
6: ["Crafting Your Desktop Companion...", "Your pet is being generated and prepared for your desktop. This usually takes 2-3 minutes."]
7: ["Welcome Home! Claim Your 100 Starter Treats", "Your companion has arrived on your desktop with starter treats ready to use.", "+100 Starter Treats Unlocked"]
8: ["Ready to Start Living with Your Pet", "Follow these steps to feed, interact with, and summon your companion on screen."]
9: ["We will play a chime when your pet lands on your desktop."]
